task.title: TG /vibecode: khach complain khong dung duoc Claude va Gemini khi bat VPN
task.detail: Nguyen van chu du an (bus #604, owner -> win, 2026-09-30T06:57:01Z): 'kiem tra: khach complain khong dung duoc claude va gemini khi vpn'. Pham vi: (1) xac dinh 'khong dung duoc' la claude.ai/gemini.google.com tren trinh duyet hay provider Claude/Gemini trong app; (2) do THAT tu may Windows dang bat VPNFlow (egress 165.101.114.162) va doi chung khi TAT VPN; (3) ket luan nguyen nhan goc + huong xu ly cho khach; ghi bang chung vao docs/evidence.
